name: 终端矩阵
description: 老派黑客终端风，纯黑 #0A0A0A + 荧光绿 #00FF41 单色通透，全局等宽字体 JetBrains Mono。H1 左 4px 绿条+uppercase 大字距、H2 绿色粗体+ `>` 风装饰、p 等宽绿色 14px、blockquote 左条缩进、hr 绿色虚线。专门用于极客向技术笔记/黑客文化/CTF writeup/OS 深度/CLI 工具教程。(vs cyber-neon 用青+品红双色装饰多,本主题单绿单调工程感)

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #00FF41; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding-left: 20px; border-left: 4px solid #00FF41; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h2: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #00FF41; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding-left: 16px; border-left: 3px solid #00FF41; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #00CC33; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 2px dashed #00CC33;
styles.h4: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #008F2C; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #70C970; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #4A7A4A; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #B0F5B0; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.2px;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 2px solid #00FF41; background: transparent; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 13px; color: #70C970; line-height: 1.7; font-style: italic;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 13px; color: #70C970; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.a: color: #00FF41; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-underline-offset: 3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0; display: block; border: 1px solid #00FF41; background: transparent; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 1px dashed #00FF41;
styles.code: background: rgba(0,255,65,0.12); border-radius: 0; font-size: 90%; color: #00FF41; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #000000; border: 1px solid #1A3A1A; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #00FF41; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; background: #00FF41; color: #000000; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #00FF41; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 13px; border: 1px dashed rgba(0,255,65,0.3);
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #00FF41; background: rgba(0,255,65,0.15); border-bottom: 1px solid #00FF41; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
styles.li: font-size: 14px; color: #B0F5B0; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.2px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #00FF41; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 11px; color: #70C970; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; word-break: break-all;
